meta: Care for your dog or cat with AI: set a clear feeding and vaccination schedule and know which signs mean go to the vet now.

muc.title: Forgetting vaccinations
muc.text: You keep forgetting your pet's vaccinations or feed them by feel. AI helps you set a clear schedule.

muc.title: By age and weight
muc.text: Tell AI the species, age and weight, and ask for the number of meals and foods it must never eat.

muc.title: From booklet to calendar
muc.text: Photograph the vaccination booklet, ask AI to pull out vaccine and deworming dates, then set phone reminders.

muc.title: Signs to see the vet
muc.text: Ask AI to list signs that need a vet right away, like not eating, frequent vomiting or trouble breathing. If something seems off, see the vet; don't wait on AI.

muc.title: A one-week schedule
muc.text: Ask a chatbot for a one-week pet care schedule with feeding times, play times and bath days.
